title: Candida albicans Metabolic Processes and Gene Regulation
summary: This cluster revolves around Candida albicans, an organism with various genes and proteins, including Met32, which regulates methionine biosynthesis and interacts with Met4. Met32 also binds to several genes and proteins, including JLP11, SOA1, and Seo13. Candida albicans utilizes RSS and is damaged by HT-29. The organism has genes for MUP1, Cbf1, and SOA1, and has medium MDM and SLD. Met32 mutant is a strain of Candida albicans. Glutathione requires Met32 and transports Seo13. Francisella novicida and human host are related to Candida albicans through import of GSH.
